title: Peak Demand and Load-Shifting Opportunities
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue (`emporia:circuit`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, and smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=emporia:circuit
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats avg(power_w) as avg_w by hour circuit
| where hour>=17 AND hour<=21 AND avg_w>500
| sort - avg_w
description: Identifies which circuits draw the most power during expensive peak hours so you can shift dishwashers, dryers, and charging to cheaper times.
value: Load shifting is free money on a time-of-use tariff; pinpointing peak-hour loads shows exactly what to reschedule.
implementation: Ingest per-circuit power; schedule weekly and target the biggest peak-hour loads for shifting.
visualization: Heatmap of circuit power by hour with peak hours highlighted.
grandmaExplanation: It finds what uses the most electricity during the expensive evening hours, so you can run it later when power is cheaper.
